text_block_list.text:

just... lately, your knee looked like it 
was giving you trouble.

text_block_list.text:

who's looked after me for years 
recommended it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If it looks like you won't use it, you can 
just give it back.
